visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is divided into sections with a recurring light-blue cartoon cat pattern in the background. The top displays a colorful game logo for "明星3缺1" and a promotional slogan. The central frame shows a digital Mahjong game interface where a female cartoon avatar on the right holds a tile. At the bottom, a large cartoon cat with exaggerated teary eyes and a distressed expression trembles continuously. (2) As the gameplay progresses, a male cartoon avatar based on a real-life celebrity appears on the left side of the table. Interactive game buttons like "Pon" and "Hu" appear in a variety-show style overlay in the center. The Mahjong tiles on the table shift as the game logic proceeds, while the bottom cat continues its animated shaking. (3) The sequence concludes with a large graphical victory overlay for "Big Three Dragons" (大三元) accompanied by flashing effects. The crying cat at the bottom remains the visual anchor. A final rectangular button with a call to action appears over the Mahjong table interface against the background pattern.

He speaks with high arousal and a playful cadence, matching the visual of a game win. The music bed ducks slightly to allow the vocal to remain distinct while maintaining the high-energy atmosphere. (3) A celebratory jingle and digital UI sound effects punctuate the end of the vocal phrase. The music reaches its peak and transitions into a short, punchy cadence as the audio loop concludes. The overall mix is crisp, bright, and highly compressed, typical of mobile gaming content.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for a mobile Mahjong game. It uses high-energy BGM and exaggerated cartoon visuals (the crying cat mascot) to grab attention. The narrative highlights the thrill of a high-scoring win (Big Three Dragons) to entice viewers to download and play the game.
